versions.content: Suffix used for the resulting name of the PortInterface for the Data Services The suffix used for the resulting name of the PortInterface for the Data Services ( DataServices_{Data} ) shall be taken from the shortName of the SwcServiceDependency that aggregates the DiagnosticIoControlNeeds .
